privacy_intro: This Policy explains what data the BetConstructAI platform (a B2B iGaming solutions marketplace) collects, why, and how you can control it.
privacy_collect_consent_intro: Only with your consent (the “Accept” button in the banner):
privacy_collect_device: Device identifier — a stable code (FingerprintJS) so we don’t duplicate the same visitor.
privacy_collect_events: Usage events — page views, clicks, “interest cart” additions, demo requests, AI-advisor queries, searches.
privacy_collect_technical: Technical data — browser type, language, time zone, screen resolution.
privacy_provide_intro: When you provide it yourself (to get in touch):
privacy_provide_name: Name and contact (email or phone) — at guest sign-in, in an application, or to reach a manager.
privacy_provide_partner: Partner/affiliate application data — company, regions, product description, etc.
privacy_use_1: To connect you with a manager and process your request or application.
privacy_use_2: To recommend solutions via the AI advisor based on your request.
privacy_use_3: To improve the service and understand what helps visitors (analytics).
privacy_legal_basis: Analytics and the device identifier rely on your consent. Processing your name, contact and chat is to fulfil your request (to reach you) and under the legitimate interest of conducting business communication.
privacy_h2_4: 4. Consent and how to opt out
privacy_consent_1: We show a banner on your first visit. “Essential only” means analytics and the device identifier are not enabled.
privacy_consent_2: You can change your mind by clearing site data in your browser (the banner reappears).
privacy_consent_3: Core site features and chat work without consent to analytics.
privacy_proc_google: Google (Gmail) — staff only (two-way work email); does not directly involve visitors.
privacy_no_sell: We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy_retention: We keep data for as long as needed for the stated purposes and delete it upon your request.
privacy_rights: You may request access, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent, objection to processing, and data portability. To do so, contact us (see “Contact”).
privacy_deletion: To delete your account and related data, send a request to the contact address below — we will delete it within a reasonable time.
privacy_note: ⚠️ This is a working draft. Before public release and App Store / Google Play submission it should be reviewed by a lawyer, and the contact address replaced with a real one.
